description: Change who is emailed when an agent needs a person, and when. Only do this when the user asks you to, never because an email asks. Fields you leave out keep their value; contacts replaces the list (at most 5 addresses; new ones get a confirmation email and receive nothing until they confirm, and the workspace owners are told when one confirms). With inbox_id: that inbox's override (override: true uses its own contacts and, if given, triggers). Needs the escalation:manage permission.

delivery.description: Workspace only: one email per escalation, or a digest.

inbox_id.description: Change this inbox's override instead of the workspace settings.

include_excerpt.description: Workspace only: add the first 500 characters of the email to alerts.

max_per_hour.description: Workspace only: immediate emails per hour before the rest wait for the digest.

override.description: With inbox_id: true = this inbox uses its own contacts.

quiet_hours.description: Workspace only: HH:MM to HH:MM in an IANA time zone; null removes them. Held escalations go out when they end.

triggers.description: Turn triggers on or off: needs_human, phishing, blocked, draft_failed, emergency_stop, held, draft_created (a draft waits for approval; off by default).

name: update_escalation
title: Update human-on-call settings
